description: Book, change or clear cells of your own timesheet: up to 100 at once, ALL OR NOTHING. Every cell is checked by the same rules as the Timesheets grid before any is written; if one is refused, none is, and the error names it by index. A cell that already has time is replaced (mode set, the default) or added to (mode add); minutes 0 clears it; cells you do not send are left alone. Minutes are rounded to the workspace step. A day may not pass 24 hours. Refusals: not_bookable with a reason (date_in_future, period_closed, initiative_closed, no_current_quarter_key_result, not_linked, enabling_work, initiative_not_in_program), day_over_limit, initiative_not_found, duplicate_entry (the same initiative and day twice), time_recording_disabled. Use the initiativeId values anyforge_get_timesheet_week lists. An empty list writes nothing and returns written: 0.

entries.description: The cells to write, each initiative and day once.

initiativeId.description: The initiative id, or an overhead category key such as @meetings.

minutes.description: Minutes for the cell. 0 clears it.

mode.description: set (default) replaces the minutes; add adds to them.

note.description: A note on the cell. Left out: the note is kept. null or "": cleared.

today.description: Your local date (YYYY-MM-DD), honoured within a day of UTC. Pass it when you are not on UTC, so yesterday and today mean yours.

name: anyforge_book_time
title: Book time
